term: more and less in being (the order of degrees of being)
resolution: `MoreIn esse` is one primitive comparative in every result; this record says which order model each use takes. As orders the two senses do not differ: an order by approach to a primary is a homogeneous scale for the preorder pulled back along `near` (`ApproachToPrimaryReading.homogeneousLift`). They differ in the strict primacy of one distinguished being and, for causation, in the separate causal clause of q.13 a.5. Aquinas' sense is the attribution order (q.3 a.5 ad 2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A5-AD2-APPROACH-ORDER-A); strict primacy is a reading choice, load-bearing in QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING and QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-UNIQUE-MAXIMUM. Verdicts on the frontier premises: (1) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS: on the homogeneous scale the order gives it no support but is consistent with it (STMT-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE-GIVES-NO-CAUSE-OF-BEING); on the attribution order its instance at being is derived from strict primacy and the causal order to the primary (STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS), so at being it survives re-read as a consequence of q.13 a.5, while the principle for other perfections stays open. (2) STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: its source sense is synonymous (Met. II.1, 993b24-26: the synonymous quality), the univocal sense, where it is consistent but unsupported; on the attribution order it holds for the primary as cause and fails in general (STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH). It therefore needs re-reading at being: restricted to the primary it is derivable, and the AT-MOST-ONE route uses it only there; applied with the primary as effect (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING) it is neither derivable on the attribution order nor available in its synonymous sense, since q.13 a.5 (arg. 1 and ad 1) denies that the first agent is a univocal cause; that use equivocates unless separately sourced. (3) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING: neither order yields it, even with the causal order and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (STMT-ORDER-READINGS-DO-NOT-YIELD-FIRST-BEING). On the attribution order the maximum is the primary, so the bridge reduces to: nothing other than the primary is simply prior to it; it stays open.
